title: Humane editorial
summary: A well-made magazine about technology that feels human: calm, warm, crafted. The product is technical, but the page leads with feeling.
use_when: Products that want trust through calm: developer tools that sell on taste, consumer AI, anything priced on quality rather than features.
avoid_when: Dense dashboards, or anything that must feel fast and aggressive. Serif plus slow motion reads as considered, not urgent.
